assets.caption: Fig. 600-9 Recommended Welding Details for Hot Tap Connections
assets.notes: Table with detail types listed below; includes footnotes and cross-references

footnotes: Detail Type 1: Full encirclement type — Encirclement sleeve (API 1107 Figure 14), Encirclement tee or split tee (API 1107 Figure 15), Encirclement sleeve and saddle (API 1107 Figure 16), Encirclement saddle (API 1107 Figure 17).
Detail Type 2: Partial encirclement type — Nozzle and padding pad (API 1107 Figure 12), Nozzle and reinforcing saddle (API 1107 Figure 13).
Detail Type 3: Self-reinforcing type — Weldolet, threadolet—Std. Dwg. GC-L3H9B.
Note: The saddle or reinforcing pad should be equipped with a vent hole to provide venting during welding operations. After welding, the vent hole should be plugged with grease.
See the following: Corporation Piping Specification, Branch Reinforcement Tables. Standard Drawing GC-L3H9B—Standard Piping Details and Construction Notes.
